# Landscape support files

The three files listed in `docs/landscape-source-provenance.json` were copied without modification from Landscape 1.32.0 in the pinned official Urbit bootstrap pill. Their existing source comments are retained.

Upstream: https://github.com/tloncorp/landscape

The complete permission/copyright notice for this support code is preserved in `third_party/urbit/LICENSE.txt` (packaged as `THIRD_PARTY/urbit-LICENSE.txt`). It is the authentic MIT notice from [Urbit source commit d6ec15f](https://github.com/urbit/urbit/blob/d6ec15fbcb5675af6ac722e6f512f399a5fdbaef/LICENSE.txt), SHA-256 `b5d62c0a6f6b17ff490de29606527bf77b6509998ef07048488d659e2b719e52`.

The library and type files are byte-identical to that licensed tree's `pkg/landscape/lib/docket.hoon` and `pkg/landscape/sur/docket.hoon`. The mark matches `pkg/landscape/mar/docket-0.hoon` after removing trailing horizontal whitespace; no substantive code differs. Exact copied/upstream hashes and the whitespace comparison are recorded in `docs/landscape-source-provenance.json`. The files remain unchanged from the pinned pill export.

The earlier root/recursive check of tloncorp/landscape found no separate license file. This notice resolves the copied code's provenance through its matching MIT-licensed Urbit source; it does not invent a Tlon copyright attribution. Preserve the authentic notice and this comparison record with any distribution. Source ownership/contact and public publication remain separate release decisions.
